name: GeekPost for X
author: Tecnología Geek

sections.description:
GeekPost for X — Automático posts a tweet with the title and the link of every new post you publish, using the official X API and your own developer keys. No middleman accounts, no third-party posting services: your site talks directly to X with your credentials.

You paste your four keys once (API Key, API Key Secret, Access Token, Access Token Secret), turn on the master switch, and every new post goes out to X by itself. Sending is decoupled with WP-Cron, so publishing a post is never blocked or slowed down by the API.

Free version:

  • Auto-post on publish: fixed template “title + link”, always within the 280-character limit (the link counts as 23, hashtags never break it).
  • Master switch: the plugin is born switched off and posts nothing until you enable it.
  • Per-post checkbox in the editor: skip any post you do not want tweeted.
  • Anti-duplicate protection: a post is tweeted once, ever. Editing it never re-posts it.
  • Attempt log in the settings panel: sent, skipped and errors, with the tweet text.
  • Test tweet button to validate your keys.
  • Optional footer credit line (“GeekPost for X · Created by Tecnología Geek”): off by default and controlled by a free switch in the settings. It only appears if you turn it on.
  • Translation ready: every string uses the geekpost-for-x text domain and follows your site language; translations are delivered as WordPress.org language packs (Spanish included).

Premium version (available at tecnologiageek.com/plugins):

  • Editable tweet template with the variables {titulo}, {enlace}, {categoria} and {hashtags}.
  • Hashtags per category (plus default hashtags).
  • Featured image attached to the tweet automatically.
  • Post only in the categories you choose.
  • Adjustable delay in minutes before tweeting.
  • Dedicated tweet history page.
  • Re-post button for old posts (always respecting the anti-duplicate protection).

Important: you need your own X developer account and your own app keys. X charges for API usage on a pay-per-use basis and you pay X directly; this plugin includes no keys, no credits and no posting service.

En español: GeekPost for X — Automático tuitea automáticamente cada entrada nueva con su título y enlace usando la API oficial de X y tus propias claves de desarrollador. Sin cuentas intermediarias ni servicios externos de publicación: tu sitio habla directo con X con tus credenciales. La versión gratuita trae la plantilla fija «título + enlace», interruptor general (el plugin nace apagado), casilla por entrada, protección anti-duplicados (una entrada se tuitea una sola vez, nunca), registro de intentos y botón de tweet de prueba. La versión Premium — disponible en tecnologiageek.com/plugins — añade la plantilla editable con las variables {titulo}, {enlace}, {categoria} y {hashtags}, hashtags por categoría, imagen destacada adjunta, publicación solo en las categorías elegidas, retraso ajustable en minutos, página de historial y botón para re-publicar entradas antiguas. Necesitas tu propia cuenta de desarrollador de X: el uso de la API es de pago por uso y lo pagas tú directamente a X; el plugin no incluye claves ni créditos.

External Service / Servicio externo

This plugin connects to one external service only: the official X API (X Corp.), used exclusively to publish tweets on your own X account, with your own API keys.

  • Endpoints used: POST https://api.x.com/2/tweets to publish a tweet. The Premium version also uses POST https://upload.twitter.com/1.1/media/upload.json to upload the featured image of a post before attaching it to the tweet.
  • What data is sent: only the tweet text you configure (by default, the title and the link of your post) and, in the Premium version, the featured image of the post. Requests are signed with OAuth 1.0a using the keys stored in your settings; your keys are sent only as part of the OAuth signature to X itself.
  • What is NOT sent: no data about your visitors, no site statistics, no telemetry, no tracking of any kind. Nothing is ever sent to the plugin author or to any other third party.
  • Requirements and costs: you must have your own X developer account and app (developer.x.com). X API usage is pay-per-use and is billed by X to you.
  • Terms and policies of the service: X Terms of Service (https://x.com/en/tos), X Developer Agreement and Policy (https://developer.x.com/en/developer-terms) and the X Privacy Policy (https://x.com/en/privacy).

En español: este plugin se conecta a un único servicio externo: la API oficial de X (X Corp.), usada exclusivamente para publicar tweets en tu propia cuenta de X, con tus propias claves. Los únicos datos enviados son el texto del tweet que tú configuras (por defecto, el título y el enlace de tu entrada) y, en la versión Premium, la imagen destacada de la entrada. No se envía ningún dato de tus visitantes, ni telemetría, ni rastreo, ni nada al autor del plugin ni a terceros. Necesitas tu propia cuenta de desarrollador de X y el uso de la API lo pagas tú directamente a X (pago por uso).
sections.installation:
1. Upload the geekpost-for-x folder to /wp-content/plugins/ or install the plugin from the WordPress panel.
  2. Activate “GeekPost for X — Automático” in the Plugins menu.
  3. Go to Settings → GeekPost for X and paste your four X API keys (API Key, API Key Secret, Access Token, Access Token Secret) from your app at developer.x.com. Your app needs Read and Write permissions and the access token must be generated after setting them.
  4. Turn on the master switch and save.
  5. (Optional) Send the test tweet to verify the connection. From now on, every new post is tweeted automatically; use the checkbox in the editor to skip a specific post.
sections.faq:
Do I need an X developer account?

Yes. The plugin posts with YOUR keys from YOUR X developer app (developer.x.com). It includes no keys and no posting service.

How much does the X API cost?

X charges for API usage on a pay-per-use basis and bills you directly (for example, creating a post has a per-request cost in X pricing). This plugin has no control over and receives nothing from those charges. Check the current pricing in the X developer console before enabling the plugin.

Does it tweet when I edit or update a post?

No. It only tweets when a post is published for the first time, and the anti-duplicate protection guarantees a post is never tweeted twice.

Can I skip a post?

Yes. Unmark the “Post to X when published” checkbox in the editor of that post, or keep the master switch off.

The plugin does not tweet. What do I check?

The master switch is on, the four keys are complete, your app has Read and Write permissions, and the Access Token was regenerated after changing permissions. The attempt log in Settings → GeekPost for X shows the exact error returned by X for each attempt.

What does the Premium version add?

Editable template with variables, hashtags per category, featured image attached, chosen categories only, delay in minutes, history page and re-posting of old posts. Available at tecnologiageek.com/plugins.
sections.changelog:
2.1.2

  • Spanish translation included (es_ES): the whole plugin, settings and log, in Spanish.

2.1.1

  • Maintenance: translator notes added to every placeholder string and small output-escaping touches requested by the WordPress.org automated scan. No behavior changes.

2.1.0

  • The footer credit line is now a free, opt-in setting in BOTH versions (it was always on in the free version and its switch was Premium). It is born off; nothing is printed in your footer unless you enable it.
  • Internal prefix unified to pubx_ (4+ characters) for functions, options, cron hooks and post meta, following the WordPress.org review guidelines. Your existing keys, settings and anti-duplicate history migrate automatically on update.
  • The free package no longer bundles translation files: translations now arrive as WordPress.org language packs.

2.0.1

  • New: brand footer badge — a small centered line at the very end of every page, “GeekPost for X · Created by Tecnología Geek”, linked to tecnologiageek.com/plugins. It always shows in the free version; the Premium version adds a free on/off switch in the settings page.

2.0.0

  • Product release. Bilingual (English source, full Spanish translation included).
  • Free: auto-post with fixed title + link template, master switch (born off), per-post checkbox, anti-duplicate protection, attempt log and test tweet.
  • Premium: editable template with variables, hashtags per category, featured image, chosen categories, delay, history page and re-posting of old posts, activated with a license key.
